publication.title: Monitoring the Electrochemical Failure of Indium Tin Oxide Electrodes via Operando Ellipsometry
publication.scope: Optical-model fit for the original commercial ITO/glass sample; not a generic ITO composition.

references_raw: A. Minenkov, S. Hollweger, J. Duchoslav, O. Erdene-Ochir, M. Weise, E. Ermilova, A. Hertwig, M. Schiek. Monitoring the electrochemical failure of indium tin oxide electrodes via operando ellipsometry. ACS Appl Mater Interfaces 16, 9517-9531 (2024) (Numerical data kindly provided by Manuela Schiek)
comments_raw: 110 nm thick ITO layer on glass type XY15S purchased from Xinyan Technology LTD.

conditions.unknown_condition_policy: Not confirmed for this commercial sample; do not borrow wafer sample preparation parameters.

range_note: The imported range is the official numerical table domain. It is not claimed to be an independently verified measurement or fit-validity range. The operando liquid-cell measurement window is a separate experiment.

adaptation.numeric_values: All wavelength, n and k rows preserved exactly as decimal values from the single source table.
adaptation.interpolation: Existing product in-domain linear interpolation only; no added source samples or extrapolation.
adaptation.schema_validation: Existing validate_optical_sets and exact material/role importer.
